title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalamu alaikum Mufti saab; i have a question regarding the UMRAH.i live in Riyadh. I went to makkah to perform UMRAH. Kindly please advice if i had to perform UMRAH since i came from Jeddah to board the bus in Makkah. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 36980 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: My friends is doing job in Saudi Arabia for almost 3 years. They performed many umrah Question: My friends is doing job in Saudi Arabia for almost 3 years. They performed many umrah. On their first Umrah they cut their hair but later on they performed umrah without cutting their hairs. Please guide me it is correct or wrong? If it is wrong then what is the penalty in Islam? Answer ID: 36980 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 517/239/L=1433) It is wajib to do halaq or qasr after performing the rituals of umrah. If your friends performed second umrah after their first umrah without doing halaq or qasr then one dam (slaughter of an animal) shall be wajib. Likewise, if after second umrah they performed third umrah without doing halaq then a second dam shall also be wajib. The same case shall apply to the fourth and fifth umrah. If, during this period, they did any other jinayah then more dams shall be wajib on them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
